capabilities: Run several external AI agents from a sidebar chat
Sign in in-app by device flow, API key or OAuth
Gate reads, writes and deletes with three-tier confirmations
Search the web and pull pages or images into notes
Reopen recent sessions from local history
extras: Desktop only, local filesystem vaults. Installed manually by copying build artifacts (main.js, mcp-bridge.js, manifest.json, styles.css) into .obsidian/plugins/. WorkBuddy credentials are Tencent-KMS encrypted and cannot be read locally; QwenWork/Qoder CN sessions expire after about 10 days; chat history is stored in the plugin folder's history.json (last 50 sessions). README states no telemetry and lists every contacted endpoint.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to let external coding agents read and edit vault notes, so using them normally means a separate terminal with unrestricted machine access.
